title: Design System: 書籍製作工作台

display.purpose: 19-point bold Microsoft JhengHei; Tk points scale with Windows.

manuscript.purpose: 12-point Microsoft JhengHei, Tk spacing1=3 and spacing3=8 pixels; no CSS line-height authored.

native.mode: Operate; extension of pinned A workbench
native.scrolling: Independent vertical manuscript scrollbars; separate inspector canvas scrollbar.
native.cornerRadius: Not authored; native theme owns control geometry.
native.focus: Text highlightcolor is primary with 1px highlightthickness. Buttons use native theme focus. HTML tile focus is an illustrative viewer affordance.
native.ramps: Synthesized viewer-only ramps for accent and paper; not adopted application colors. Frontmatter hex values are authoritative.

verification.limits: Does not establish keyboard traversal, all dialog/state behavior, persistence, or clean Windows installation.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Save or confirm import. Illustrative HTML translation; actual control is native Tkinter.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Create or open a book project. Illustrative HTML translation; actual control is native Tkinter.

narrative.overview:
This documents the existing A workbench in Operate mode. It extends the selected green and paper visual system into native Windows Tkinter; it does not establish a new visual world. Clear Traditional Chinese labels, quiet surfaces, and simultaneous source/draft comparison support sustained proofreading.

The current implementation is the authority for native values. `prototype.css` preserves the inherited direction; its browser radii, shadows, serif paper styling, and responsive rules are reference material rather than Tkinter requirements. Product scope comes from `PRODUCT.md`; the selected composition is recorded in ADR 0003.
keyCharacteristics: Muted green actions and dark green text on quiet light surfaces.
Paper source beside a white editable manuscript.
Persistent book/batch context and a separate confirmation inspector.
Native controls with explicit status and disabled-function explanations.

rules.name: The Action Green Rule
rules.body: Reserve solid green for the active step and meaningful primary actions; manuscript surfaces stay light.

rules.name: The Comparison Rule
rules.body: Keep source and draft independently readable and scrollable while retaining batch context and reachable inspector actions.

dos: **Do** retain the calm green/paper system and native Microsoft JhengHei hierarchy.
**Do** preserve independent manuscript scrolling and a separately scrollable inspector.
**Do** keep unavailable actions legible and explain their dependencies nearby.
**Do** verify supported window sizes with real native captures and treat source/draft distinction as functional hierarchy.
donts: **Don't** replace the selected A workbench with wizard or batch-console composition without a new design decision.
**Don't** import browser-specific shadows, radii, serif typography, or mobile breakpoints as if they were native tokens.
**Don't** imply online proofreading, reading confirmation, audio, or video succeeds before those functions exist.
